quest.title: Gifts and Gifts in Return
quest.description: Your Saurian companion gifts you the treasures it had been carefully collecting. Now, what would make a good thank-you gift...?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excuse me... Um, are you Master Kulahaw?

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: That is, in fact, my name...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, so you're the Gem Master who is looking for inspiration! We came looking for you based on Imix's recommendation. We noticed you were staring at the tree just now. Were you in the middle of mining for gems of creativity?

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: Uh, actually... Forget it. It's not important anymore... *sigh* Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #We've brought a beautiful gemstone, and we were hoping you'd process it for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, c'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, show him!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehhh!?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #You hear the fluttering of avian wings by your ears...\nBy the time you recover, the gem has vanished from {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s claws without a trace.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Raaaaah! Roaaaargh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha— Waitasec, where's the gem? Where could such a huge gem have gone off to?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like a bird nicked it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the heck? The birds here steal stuff? Rude!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roooawr! Rooooawr!

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: Actually, what I was about to say was, even if the gem hadn't just been stolen, I still couldn't help you cut it...

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: ...Since all my tools were also stolen by those damn birds! I was actually just carefully looking at those birds, going over them one by one, to see which one of them had their dirty claws on my tools.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Is... Is that even possible? These birds are just the worst! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's go get that gem back!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: And don't forget about my tools too—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon had a guess when she saw the pillars outside, but she really didn't expect to end up here...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you like this place, at least! Though it does make sense, after all, you must've spent a lot of time here before you met us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders if those glowing pillars will disappear after we leave this time... Still, let's clean up a bit first, then rest for a while!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #You, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, and Paimon tidy up the place together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, now it's looking pretty good!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, you're pretty excited, aren't 'cha, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Do you have something you wanna tell us?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroh... Rrrawr...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Do you want us to turn around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You didn't prepare a surprise for us, did you? Heehee, you're as easy to read as an open book!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, then, we'll play along!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #You and Paimon turn around, and all you can hear is the continuous clinking and jingling.\nIt sounds like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is tinkering with something...\nAfter a short while, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} lets out a "Rawr rawr!". It's probably time to turn back around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's a lot of stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon have a look! Let's see, a super straight branch, a really round rock... And some strange food with a weird color and smell. Well, that's probably been left out for who knows how many days...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You carefully selected and collected all these, didn't you? Are they gifts for us?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, we can't eat food that's been left out for too long! Whoever eats it — and that includes you — would get an upset stomach! So we've gotta deal with that first...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Arroooo... Rooooawr...

choices.text: But this branch is really something!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! It feels like it'd be every bit as impressive as a master sword when you wave it around!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmmhmm, we'll happily take it all! Hehe, just put it all in Paimon's secret stash's backpack pouch! Maybe they'll come in handy someday!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm, since {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} gave us a gift, we should give him a gift in return.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon see what she's got in her secret stash...

choices.text: Wow. Your seldom-seen generous side makes an appearance...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} went out of his way to show us how much he cares, that's not something to take lightly! Also, if it gets too heavy, Paimon can't really fly, so maybe Paimon can give him some...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ta-da! It's a super shiny gem! Do you like it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Guess Paimon's picked just the thing, huh? Hey, be careful now! Don't drop it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Oh boy. Why does Paimon feel like you'll lose the gem if you hold onto it like that...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we go find the Children of Echoes? If anyone's got gemsmiths who could shape it for us, it'd be them!

choices.text: Just what have you squirreled away, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon said it's her secret, private stash! Even if we're the bestest of buddies, that's not something Paimon can just tell you, you know! Anyway, there's plenty enough to give {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} a gift!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it's shiny, too! Hehe, we've crossed a lotta rivers, and we've seen lots of round rocks, so you can believe us when we say this stone is a gem amongst rocks!

talks.objective: Look for a jeweler's shop in the Children of Echoes

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here. Master Kulahaw has already left your processed gem in the shop, leaving instructions that I personally deliver it to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Master Kulahaw isn't here today either?

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: That's right, he's out gathering inspiration yet again. By the way, he also made a set of locks to carry with him, saying it was to prevent his tools from being stolen... Which is weird... Would anyone want to steal our cutting tools and sell them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course they wouldn't! It's becau—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (...So Imix still doesn't know they were stolen by birds... Let's spare Kulahaw the embarrassment!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Because... Because there's someone who thinks they can steal his skills that way too, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Forget it... Anyway, we'll take the gem! The shape is so pretty. That's what you'd call a "masterwork," huh?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} really likes it too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Allow me to thank you on {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Hey now, as long as your little Saurian likes it! I'll be sure to pass on your compliments to Master Kulahaw, please come again!

talks.objective: Speak to the apprentice at the shop

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Welcome to our shop! If you'd like us to cut a gemstone, you're in the right place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there! We do have a gemstone here, and we'd like to have it custom-processed. It's for our little Tepetlisaurus companion, ta-da! Here it is—

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Wow! This gem is of truly exceptional quality! Look at the size, and how clear it is... If you'd like a custom job, the processing will be quite difficult...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that sounds familiar. So what's next, extra fees?

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: No! Of course not! Just what kind of person do you think I am!?

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Our shop specializes in the art of cutting and polishing gemstones. If we run into a good one, we'd rather polish it for free, and let its beauty speak for our quality as it carries our name out into the world. We'd never set high prices willy-nilly!

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: But just as a good artisan seeks the best materials to work with, so do the best gemstones require a suitable artisan to work them. I know just such a "Gem Master," and he would be perfect for doing this one justice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's amazing! Quick, call the Gem Master out!

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Aha, but you might need to make an appointment in advance if you'd like to see him. If you don't, chances are he'll be out seeking inspiration...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seeking inspiration?

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Yeah! Master Kulahaw is pretty unusual even among master craftsmen. He doesn't believe that artisans should just polish a gemstone according to blueprints, but that they should understand how to observe all the beauty the natural world has to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: For example, learning polishing techniques from the tiny ripples on a lake's surface, or fretwork patterns from the shifting and billowing clouds... he calls it gathering inspiration!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Sounds kinda complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Still, if you're in a hurry, you can go out and find him wherever he happens to be gathering inspiration from! Let me mark where he said he was going for you.

talks.objective: Look for the jeweler at the place he's gathering inspiration
Retrieve the lost gem and the tools
Report back to the Gem Master

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: Can this be!? My tools are back! Oh, this is amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: I didn't get a good look before, but I must say, now that's one pretty gem! It's got the same fleshy yellow as a bird's tarsus... Bah! I shan't use those blasted scoundrels in my analogies.

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: Like the sky just brightening at dawn, like the first rays of the sun, that kind of early morning sky color... Yeah, that's a good description...

choices.text: For a master, your metaphors aren't very masterful...

response.speaker: Kulahaw
response.text: Hey, I'm no storyteller! Really, all I need to do is remember the beautiful colors of nature... Using pretty words to describe them isn't my forte.

response.speaker: Kulahaw
response.text: Either way, just leave the gem to me. As I said before, I'll process it for free. Consider it a gift for your help in retrieving my tools. As for how long it'll take... Drop by the Gemporium in two days' time!

choices.text: So that's the meaning of "gathering inspiration"?

response.speaker: Kulahaw
response.text: Oh? So you've heard of the practice before?

talks.objective: Go to the gemporium to retrieve the gem

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: They're all perched up there on the tree... Could they be planning to build a nest with my tools?

dialogues.speaker: Kulahaw
dialogues.text: My brave friends, it's all up to you! Ah, the pain of being without the means to earn my own bread...
